title: Brad, 35
body: Life coach (gentle approach). Some call me Brad Whispermentor. I believe in soft motivation and reasonable sleep schedules. If you're looking for someone who WON'T yell affirmations at you at 3:47 AM, I'm your guy.
summary: Gentle life coach. Brad Whispermentor. Believes in reasonable sleep schedules.

prompts.question: My ideal first date involves...
prompts.answer: A quiet walk. Maybe some tea. Discussing our feelings at a reasonable volume. Going to bed at a sensible hour. Revolutionary, I know.

prompts.question: I believe in...
prompts.answer: Work-life balance. Getting 8 hours of sleep. Warm showers. Being kind to yourself. This makes me controversial in certain circles.

prompts.question: Looking for someone who...
prompts.answer: Doesn't think self-care is weakness. Who has hobbies that don't involve screaming at mirrors. Who likes corn, gently.
